description: This file contains functions for rewriting and optimizing Torch JIT graphs for Vulkan backend, including pattern-based graph rewrites, prepacked operator insertion, backend transfer management, and overall module optimization for mobile deployment.

methods.name: insertPrePackedBatchNormOp
methods.description: Inserts prepacked batch normalization operations into the graph.

methods.name: insertPrePackedLinearOp
methods.description: Inserts prepacked linear layer operations into the graph.

methods.name: insertPrePackedLayernormOp
methods.description: Inserts prepacked layer normalization operations into the graph.

methods.name: insertPrePackedConv2dOp
methods.description: Inserts prepacked 2D convolution operations into the graph.

methods.name: insertPrePackedConv1dOp
methods.description: Inserts prepacked 1D convolution operations into the graph.

methods.name: transferInputOutputBackends
methods.description: Transfers input and output tensors between CPU and Vulkan backends.

methods.name: eliminateDeadCode
methods.description: Removes dead code from the module's graph.

methods.name: rewriteQuantizedOps
methods.description: Rewrites quantized operations to Vulkan-specific implementations.

methods.name: insertPrePackedGruOp
methods.description: Inserts prepacked GRU operations into the graph.

methods.name: insertPrePackedLstmOp
methods.description: Inserts prepacked LSTM operations into the graph.

methods.name: fuseHardtanhWithPackedOps
methods.description: Fuses Hardtanh activation with packed convolution operations.

methods.name: fuseReluWithPackedOps
methods.description: Fuses ReLU activation with packed convolution operations.

methods.name: vulkanInsertPrePackedOps
methods.description: Inserts all prepacked Vulkan operations into the graph.

methods.name: vulkanInsertPrePackedOps
methods.description: Inserts all prepacked Vulkan operations into the module's methods.

methods.name: vulkanFusePrePackedConvWithClamp
methods.description: Fuses clamp operations with prepacked convolution operations.

methods.name: vulkanRemoveMutation
methods.description: Removes tensor mutation operations from the graph.

methods.name: vulkanOptimizeForMobile
methods.description: Performs full optimization pipeline for mobile Vulkan deployment.
